findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.levels.fyi" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get-permissions, search-role-terms, upload-resume, add-salary-submission, search-jobs, get-job · Private data: get-profile, upload-resume, add-salary-submission · Public sink: search-locations, search-job-titles, upload-resume, add-salary-submission, send-feedback · Destructive: search-job-titles, upload-resume, search-jobs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get-permissions, search-role-terms, upload-resume, add-salary-submission, search-jobs, get-job · Private data: get-profile, upload-resume, add-salary-submission · Public sink: search-locations, search-job-titles, upload-resume, add-salary-submission, send-feedback · Destructive: search-job-titles, upload-resume, search-jobs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
